source_title: Pick of the stats: Southampton v Queens Park Rangers - BBC
source_excerpt:
Southampton and QPR will seek to showcase their Championship promotion credentials as they meet at St Mary's on Saturday (15:00 GMT).
Saints are sixth, three points outside the automatic promotion places after their 3-2 win at West Ham last Saturday, though their five game home winning streak was ended by a goalless draw against Bolton last time out at St Mary's.
QPR are level on points, two places back, after thrashing Swansea 5-0 last weekend, however the R's are winless in their past four on the road in the league.
Southampton have won each of their past six league games against QPR, as many victories as across their prior 21 meetings with the Hoops combined.
